content:
I have all the pieces now.

q20. mechanism: Server-Sent Events (SSE) — an in-process pub/sub hub that pushes JSON-encoded events over long-lived HTTP SSE connections to browser clients; hub path: `server/router/api/v1/sse_hub.go` (`SSEHub` struct, `NewSSEHub`, `Subscribe`/`Unsubscribe`/`Broadcast`/`Close`, `sse_hub.go:56-144`).

Memo/reaction handlers that broadcast through `s.SSEHub.Broadcast(...)`:
- `CreateMemo` (`server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:70`, broadcast at :163)
- `DeleteMemo` (`server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:518`, broadcast at :585)
- `CreateMemoComment` (`server/router/api/v1/memo_service_comments.go:20`, broadcast at :126)
- `UpsertMemoReaction` (`server/router/api/v1/reaction_service.go:60`, broadcast at :106)
- `DeleteMemoReaction` (`server/router/api/v1/reaction_service.go:111`, broadcast at :161)
- `dispatchMemoUpdatedSideEffects` (`server/router/api/v1/memo_update_helpers.go:66`, broadcast at :71) — a shared helper invoked by `UpdateMemo` (`memo_service.go:401`), `SetMemoAttachments`→`setMemoAttachmentsInternal` (`memo_attachment_service.go:16/48`), and `SetMemoRelations`→`setMemoRelationsInternal` (`memo_relation_service.go:16/48`), so memo update/attachment/relation changes all fan out through it.
